title: 3627. Maximum Median Sum of Subsequences of Size 3

examples.explanation: In the first step, select elements at indices 2, 4, and 5, which have a median 3. After removing these elements, nums becomes [2, 1, 2]. In the second step, select elements at indices 0, 1, and 2, which have a median 2. After removing these elements, nums becomes empty. Hence, the sum of the medians is 3 + 2 = 5.
